8e7c5c02587a9cae.description: About the Role UCC Holding is seeking a QA/QC Engineer to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position is responsible for ensuring that projects are delivered in accordance with established work practices and project specifications. The role focuses on guaranteeing work completion within specified timelines, meeting or exceeding client quality expectations through the implementation of international quality standards, plans, and procedures across all construction activities. The QA/QC Engineer will also support the development of the Project Quality Management System by establishing necessary procedures, plans, and work instructions. Key Responsibilities Assist the Project QA/QC Manager or Sr. QA/QC Engineer in implementing the quality management system at the site, adhering to the approved Project Quality Plan and IMS Procedures. Prepare and submit Work Inspection Requests (WIR) for each construction activity to the consultant, ensuring comprehensive coverage of on-site activities. Verify all incoming materials against project specifications and approved material submittals. Monitor WIRs and test reports, providing status updates to the Quality Manager and site team. Establish and monitor QA/QC Plans, Method Statements, and Test Plans before project commencement, and ensure their implementation throughout the project to meet quality requirements. Ensure document control procedures are implemented and all consultant-approved documents are distributed via the document control system. Verify the availability of the Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) and ensure all method statements and test plans are submitted to the consultant as per the approved ITP. Confirm that work inspections are conducted as planned and advise the construction team on corrective actions to prevent work rejection, aiming for a 90% first-submission pass rate for inspections. Inspect all materials internally before offering inspection to the consultant, raising Non-Conformance Reports (NCR) to suppliers for substandard deliveries. Inspection records must be included in the monthly Quality report. Maintain records of all work and material inspections, providing data for weekly progress meetings. Record all test results and ensure their availability, including mill certificates for steel. Ensure logs are available with test reports for all types of tests, as per the approved testing matrix. Verify that concrete pour cards are maintained daily, with copies provided to the storekeeper for SRV and to cost control/quantity surveyors. Support HSE initiatives, participate in safety awareness activities, and contribute to incident reporting and resolution in alignment with company and IMS policies. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a related engineering field. 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Required Skills and Knowledge Knowledge of work-related standards, specifications, and quality systems such as ISO 9001, QCS, SMACNA, ASHRAE, NFPA, with technical experience in addressing various QC issues. Understanding of local employment laws and regulations sufficient for policy analysis. In-depth knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS) or Integrated Management Systems (IMS). ERP knowledge, preferably SAP functional skills. Work Type This is a full-time position. Application Process Candidates who meet the above qualifications are encouraged to apply.

8e97f82953b9944d.description: About the Role Alfanar is seeking an SAP Integration Consultant to join its team in Riyadh, Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on developing and maintaining SAP integration solutions to ensure reliable system connectivity, seamless data exchange, and effective technical support across various applications. The position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, configure, and maintain SAP integration interfaces using Message Mapping, XSLT, Java Mapping, complex mappings, and User-Defined Functions (UDFs). Create and maintain ESR service interfaces and Integration Builder objects, including ICOs where applicable. Develop and support Web Services, Client and Server Proxies, and SAP adapters such as IDoc, JDBC, File, RFC, and SOAP. Configure alerts for SAP PI/PO and environments, including dual-stack and Java-only environments. Develop and maintain ccBPM scenarios in applicable SAP PI/PO environments. Develop and support integrations with SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, C4C, SAP Hybris, and other SAP and non-SAP applications. Apply appropriate integration patterns, communication protocols, and adapters to meet business and technical requirements. Maintain working knowledge of SLD activities and SAP landscape configuration, ensuring compliance with technical, security, and operational standards. Analyze business requirements, assess technical feasibility, define integration scope, and estimate development effort. Prepare low-level technical designs covering integration architecture, interface specifications, mappings, configurations, error handling, dependencies, and risks. Assist with project planning, technical scope definition, work plans, and activity estimates. Recommend suitable integration solutions and technical improvements based on business needs and industry best practices. Prepare and execute unit tests for integration interfaces and mappings. Validate message transformations, configurations, connectivity, and end-to-end scenarios. Identify and resolve defects, ensure compliance with quality standards, and support integration testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and deployment. Monitor and troubleshoot SAP integration interfaces, message-processing failures, connectivity issues, mapping errors, and adapter-related problems. Investigate, diagnose, and resolve advanced incidents and service requests; identify root causes and implement corrective and preventive actions. Coordinate with technical, functional, infrastructure, and external teams to resolve complex issues and meet agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Prepare and maintain high-quality technical documentation for developments and customizations, including designs, interface specifications, mapping logic, configurations, test results, deployment procedures, and troubleshooting guides. Ensure documentation meets agreed deadlines, organizational standards, and templates, supporting audits, knowledge transfer, maintenance, and future enhancements. Role Accountabilities Obtain updated soft and technical skills related to the job. Develop a vision and plan for career path achievement. Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets as per delivery schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time. Provide periodic reports detailing deviations and execution of planned tasks. Solve related problems and escalate complex operational issues. Ensure quality requirements to develop effective quality control and processes. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automation opportunities. Comply with related policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure compliance with relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in SAP integration. Demonstrated expertise in SAP PI/PO environments, including Message Mapping, XSLT, Java Mapping, and UDFs. Proficiency in developing and supporting various SAP adapters and Web Services. Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, C4C, and SAP Hybris integrations. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, focusing on critical SAP integration projects within a dynamic technical environment.

8eeb08d500a445b0.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجمع عرين العلم التعليمية عن معلم ابتدائي إجتماعيات ولغة عربية وإسلاميات للانضمام إلى فريقها التعليمي في تربه، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تدريس طلاب المرحلة الابتدائية المواد المذكورة، وتطوير خطط الدروس، وتقديم الدعم التعليمي الفردي والجماعي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع خطط الدروس بما يتوافق مع المنهج الدراسي والرؤية الأكاديمية للمدرسة، واختيار المصادر التعليمية، وتصميم المواد التعليمية والدروس باللغة العربية. تدريس الطلاب المواد المتعلقة بالاجتماعيات واللغة العربية والإسلاميات، وتقديم الدروس الفردية والجماعية، وتيسير المناقشات الصفية. إعطاء الواجبات وتنظيم الرحلات والأنشطة العملية التي تدعم العملية التعليمية، وإدارة سلوك الطلاب وتفاعلاتهم داخل الصف وخارجه. تقييم مدى تقدم الطلاب ونموهم الأكاديمي والاجتماعي بشكل دوري. تقديم المشورة للطلاب وأولياء أمورهم لتحسين الأداء والسلوك، وتحديد الطلاب الذين يحتاجون إلى اهتمام إضافي وتحديد الطرق المناسبة لتلبية احتياجاتهم. تسجيل الحضور والدرجات وأداء الطلاب بشكل فردي، وإعداد التقارير اللازمة بذلك. حضور اجتماعات الموظفين والتنسيق الفعال مع الزملاء المدرسين والمسؤولين ومساعدي المدرسين لضمان بيئة تعليمية متكاملة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال التعليم الابتدائي. القدرة على تدريس مواد الاجتماعيات واللغة العربية والإسلاميات للمرحلة الابتدائية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة تعليمية داعمة في مجمع عرين العلم التعليمية بمدينة تربه، مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، ولم يتم الإفصاح عنه في الوقت الحالي.

8e9cfacd2464bdc7.description: About the Role of F&B Manager Hilton is seeking an F&D Manager to oversee all food and beverage operations in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing various outlets, including restaurants, bars, banquets, and room service. The F&D Manager will ensure high standards of service, food quality, and guest satisfaction while focusing on profitability and hygiene. Key Responsibilities Manage the daily operations of all Food & Beverage outlets. Ensure exceptional guest service and handle guest feedback professionally. Monitor and achieve departmental revenue, profitability, and cost-control targets. Develop and implement strategies to increase food and beverage sales. Prepare and manage budgets, forecasts, and financial reports. Control labor costs, food costs, and beverage costs to maximize profitability. Ensure compliance with health, safety, sanitation, and food hygiene standards. Lead, motivate, coach, and develop the F&B team to enhance performance and engagement. Conduct regular training and performance evaluations for team members. Collaborate with the Executive Chef and other departments to ensure efficient operations. Monitor inventory levels and oversee procurement of food and beverage supplies. Ensure compliance with company policies, brand standards, and legal requirements. Plan and support special events, promotions, and banquet operations. Analyze operational performance and implement continuous improvement initiatives. Team Collaboration and Objectives The F&D Manager will work closely with the Culinary, Finance, Sales, and Operations teams. This collaboration is essential for achieving departmental and organizational objectives, ensuring seamless operations, and maintaining high standards across all food and beverage services. Required Experience Candidates for this position should possess 5-10 years of experience in a relevant food and beverage management role. This experience should demonstrate a strong understanding of F&B operations, financial management, and team leadership. Work Location This full-time position is based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role may involve responsibilities across various Hilton properties in cities such as Jeddah and Makkah. Application Process The salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

8ec124b03855f624.description: About Sulzer Sulzer is an engineering company recognized for its heritage of innovation. The company is committed to developing solutions that support a sustainable society. This full-time role is based in Al Khobar, Eastern region. Role Overview The Sr. Rotating Equipment Engineer provides technical support to customers, sales teams, service centers, and warranty teams. This role focuses on identifying opportunities for upgrades and services, primarily within the Oil & Gas, Power, and Water industries. Candidates should have over 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Provide technical support to customers and front-end teams, including responding to technical queries and attending meetings for clarifications. Offer technical support to service centers and field service, which involves reviewing inspection reports, recommending repair methods, identifying potential causes of failure, and suggesting upgrades. Provide guidance for the strip-down, assembly, and setting of complex equipment, and assist with instructions for complex commissioning or troubleshooting. Conduct root cause failure analysis by gathering data, reviewing site reports, and preparing detailed analysis reports with recommendations. Perform on-site performance assessments, including taking measurements with specialized equipment, analyzing collected data, and preparing detailed reports. Liaise with Sulzer factories and overseas engineering teams for additional equipment information to address customer queries or support analyses. Collaborate with Sales, Tendering, and Engineering to develop repair and retrofit proposals that meet customer requirements. Oversee and arrange drawings, Bills of Material, and specifications for detailed engineering required for equipment modification and upgrades in service centers. Conduct or supervise reverse engineering of components using conventional measuring tools and 3D scanning. Support warranty teams with issues encountered during installation, commissioning, operation, and repair of rotating equipment. Assist in warranty claim investigations, including troubleshooting, root cause failure analysis, and preparing technical reports. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in rotating equipment engineering or a related field. Demonstrated ability to provide technical support and solutions in industrial environments. Experience with root cause failure analysis and performance assessment methodologies. Proficiency in liaising with various internal and external stakeholders. Work Environment This role is a full-time position within a global team, offering opportunities to grow expertise and contribute to innovative solutions. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. Application Information Salary details for this position will be disclosed during the application process. Sulzer values a diverse workforce and is recognized as a Top Employer in multiple countries.

8ea26c7680a72e48.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة احمد يحى ناصر اليامى للمقاولات عن كاتب موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في بقيق، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم عمليات الموارد البشرية من خلال إدارة سجلات الموظفين ومعالجة الطلبات المختلفة، مع التركيز على الدقة والسرية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية حفظ وتحديث سجلات الموظفين، وتسجيل البيانات الشخصية للموظفين الجدد، والتأكد من اكتمال الوثائق المقدمة. معالجة ومتابعة طلبات التوظيف والترقية والنقل والإعارة، وجمع البيانات الإضافية عند الضرورة. تسجيل الوقوعات المتعلقة بحالة الموظف وتحديث بياناته المسجلة، وحفظ المستندات المؤيدة لهذه الوقوعات، وإخطار الجهات المعنية. الحفاظ على سرية بيانات الموظفين والتعامل معها بحرص، والتحقق من عدم تسريبها أو تداولها إلا مع الأطراف المعنية وفقاً للتعليمات المحددة. إعداد التقارير المتعلقة بالتوظيف ورفعها إلى المختصين. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الموارد البشرية أو دور إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع البيانات الحساسة والحفاظ على سريتها. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية ممتازة. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إدخال البيانات وحفظ السجلات. مهارات تواصل فعالة كتابياً وشفوياً. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والالتزام بالتعليمات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة احمد يحى ناصر اليامى للمقاولات في مدينة بقيق بالمنطقة الشرقية. يتميز بيئة العمل بالتركيز على الالتزام بالمعايير المهنية في إدارة الموارد البشرية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

8eaa5dec8f5f83b3.description: About The Ritz-Carlton Hotel Company, *** The Ritz-Carlton Hotel Company, *** operates over 100 award-winning hotels globally, committed to creating memorable guest experiences. The company aims to attract top hospitality professionals who are empowered to be creative, kind, and compassionate, setting standards for exceptional luxury service worldwide. Joining The Ritz-Carlton means becoming part of the Marriott International portfolio of brands, where employees are encouraged to achieve their best work and fulfill their purpose within a global team. Role Summary: Recreation Experience Expert The Recreation Experience Expert serves as a key resource for all recreational activities facilitated at the property. This full-time role, based in the Red Sea region, involves providing guests with information on available recreational facilities and encouraging participation in activities. The position requires 0-1 years of experience and focuses on maintaining safety, promoting a fun atmosphere, and ensuring adherence to The Ritz-Carlton's "Gold Standards" of service. Key Responsibilities Serve as a primary resource for all recreational activities, providing information on facilities such as pools, beaches, entertainment zones, fitness centers, and children's activity centers. Motivate, recruit, register, and organize guests for participation in recreational activities, fostering a fun and relaxing atmosphere. Promote and enforce facility rules and regulations to ensure guest and member safety and well-being. Monitor activity within recreational facilities and respond appropriately to emergencies according to local operating procedures. Provide cashier services for point-of-sale transactions in facilities where applicable. Assist with private group activities and events held at recreational facilities. Identify and report unsafe activity situations to supervisors or managers. Provide assistance to injured guests until emergency medical services arrive. Clean and maintain recreational facilities, equipment, and supplies. Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management; complete safety training and certifications. Operational Duties and Guest Services Comply with company policies and procedures, maintain a neat and professional appearance, protect company assets, and maintain confidentiality of company information. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guest service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Communicate with others using clear and professional language; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues; support the team to achieve common goals. Process payments for equipment rentals, recreational activities, facility rentals, or retail sales. Ensure compliance with quality expectations and standards. Physical Requirements and Work Environment Read and visually verify information in various formats. Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines for faults. Input and locate work-related information using computers or point-of-sale systems. Stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 25 lbs (11 kg) without assistance, and objects over 25 lbs (11 kg) with assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of various sizes and weights, requiring eye-hand coordination and fine motor skills. Move in confined, cramped, or elevated spaces. Move over slippery, uneven, or sloping surfaces, and ascend/descend stairs or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion Marriott International is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive environment where all individuals feel welcome and have access to career opportunities. The company actively promotes an environment that values and celebrates the diverse backgrounds of its associates, recognizing that strength lies in the fusion of cultures, talents, and experiences. Discrimination based on disability, veteran status, or other protected characteristics is not tolerated.

8efdf663716aa9d3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الشركة السعودية ريسبونس بلس للخدمات الطبية عن محصل للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يهدف هذا الدور إلى إدارة عملية تحصيل المبالغ المستحقة من الجهات والأفراد، مع ضمان الدقة والالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التحصيل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد كشوفات تفصيلية بالمبالغ المستحقة من الجهات والأشخاص. تحصيل المبالغ النقدية المستحقة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. تسجيل المبالغ المحصلة وتحديث الكشوفات بشكل مستمر. المتابعة والتنسيق مع الأطراف المعنية لضمان تحصيل المبالغ والرد على استفساراتهم. الالتزام التام بالتعليمات المتعلقة بسرية المعاملات المالية والتعامل معها بمهنية عالية. حفظ النسخ الورقية من سندات القبض والوثائق ذات الصلة وترتيبها وفقاً للسياسات المتبعة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التحصيل أو ما يعادله. القدرة على إعداد الكشوفات المالية وتحصيل المبالغ النقدية. معرفة جيدة بالسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة لعمليات التحصيل. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع الجهات والأفراد. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في تسجيل البيانات المالية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والالتزام بالتعليمات. الاحترافية في التعامل مع المعلومات المالية الحساسة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق الشركة السعودية ريسبونس بلس للخدمات الطبية. يتطلب الدور التزاماً كاملاً بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات المتبعة لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

8eff76d26bfe7ea7.description: About KBR Saudi Arabia KBR is a company focused on innovation and collaboration, committed to improving the world responsibly and safely. Strong technical understanding of maintenance management for Oil & Gas Facilities. Proven leadership skills within large organizations. Maturity of judgment under pressure and ability to resolve problems. Strategic management skills. Flexibility to travel internationally and reside in KSA. Well-organized and proactive with excellent communication skills. Ability to achieve business results in a multi-cultural environment.
